value.signature: fn encode_material (material : & AuthenticationMaterial , context : & MaterialContext) -> Result < Vec < u8 > , EncodingError >

review.body: { let bytes = material_value (material) . to_canonical_bytes () ; if bytes . len () > MATERIAL_LIMIT { return Err (EncodingError :: Bound) ; } check_material (material , context) ? ; Ok (bytes) }
review.item_premise: Public selected material and context produce canonical disclosure bytes; no key authority is established.
